description: This file defines the 'History' class, which manages a history of layout/state snapshot files for a SuiteCRM module. It provides functionality to track, retrieve, restore, and manage a list of historical layout files, supporting undo and navigation through history.

classes.name: History
classes.description: A class managing a list of history files for layouts, allowing adding, restoring, and navigating through historical states.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the History object, reconstructing past history from files or creating the history directory if needed.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the history list.

methods.name: getFirst
methods.description: Returns the most recent timestamp in the history.

methods.name: getLast
methods.description: Returns the oldest timestamp in the history.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next older timestamp in the history for navigation.

methods.name: getNth
methods.description: Returns the timestamp at the specified index in the history list.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds a new layout snapshot file to the history and manages the history list size.

methods.name: restoreByTimestamp
methods.description: Restores a saved layout snapshot identified by the timestamp.

methods.name: undoRestore
methods.description: Removes the current preview layout, effectively undoing the last restore.

methods.name: getFileByTimestamp
methods.description: Constructs the full file path for a history file given its timestamp.
